Lemma

1. ch6:6.6Let $M$ be a smooth $n$-manifold with or without boundary and $A\subseteq M$. Suppose a collection of smooth charts $\{ (U_\alpha ,\varphi _\alpha )\} $ covers $A$ and each $\varphi _\alpha (A\cap U_\alpha )$ has measure zero in $\mathbb {R}^n$. Then $A$ has measure zero in $M$.

Proof

\sketch Fix a smooth chart $(V,\psi )$. A countable subcollection of the $U_\alpha $ covers $A\cap V$. For every chart in this subcollection,

\[ \psi (A\cap V\cap U_\alpha ) =(\psi \circ \varphi _\alpha ^{-1}) \bigl(\varphi _\alpha (A\cap V\cap U_\alpha )\bigr). \]

The inner set is null by the hypothesis, and Proposition 6.5 shows that its image under the smooth transition map is null. Their countable union is $\psi (A\cap V)$, so this set is null.

□
